caption_en: Figure 8: An illustration of our sub-goal checking interface. We develop an interactive interface for annotators to checking sub-goals. Firstly, annotators play and pass the game with the interface. The reward score for each step will be given based on the labeled score. If the annotators are dissatisfied with the reward, annotators will record them and the corresponded environment will be discussed by more annotators and annotated again."
